items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 32:1
items.html: This is the rule: the upper one sorts only the degree adjacent to it. Therefore all that is sorted in the belly of Ima is ZA. And since the Nukva was already in the place of Ima, therefore Beriah, which was sorted by her, was in the aspect of ZA. (Item 56, and in the Ohr Pnimi at the subheading "and six").
